WITH SexAverages AS (
    SELECT
        p.SEX,
        AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg,
        AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    avg_acl_igg,
    avg_ana,
    avg_ana / NULLIF(AVG(avg_ana) OVER (), 0) AS relative_avg_ana
FROM SexAverages;

assumptions.assumption: The denominator is the unweighted average of the non-NULL per-sex average ANA values; sexes whose average ANA is NULL are ignored, consistent with ignoring missing values in averages.
